definitionZh: 边框图像复制的 CSS 属性定义了边框图像的侧面和中间部分的图像如何缩放和平整. 中间区域可以通过边框-图像切片属性中的关键词"填充"来显示.
sourceDefinition: The border-image-repeat CSS property defines how the images for the sides and the middle part of the border image are scaled and tiled. The middle region can be displayed by using the keyword "fill" in the border-image-slice property.
